clauses.title: Improvement
clauses.description: Address nonconformities and corrective actions, and continually improve the ISMS.
clauses.objective: Continually improve the suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness of the ISMS.

clauses.title: Context of the Organization
clauses.description: Understanding the organization and its context, the needs and expectations of interested parties, and determining the scope of the ISMS.
clauses.objective: Establish the organizational context and scope of the ISMS.

clauses.title: Leadership
clauses.description: Top management must demonstrate leadership and commitment to the ISMS, establish information security policy, and assign roles and responsibilities.
clauses.objective: Ensure top management commitment to information security.

clauses.title: Planning
clauses.description: Address risks and opportunities, set information security objectives, and plan actions to achieve them.
clauses.objective: Ensure ISMS achieves its intended outcomes and prevents/reduces undesired effects.

clauses.title: Support
clauses.description: Provide resources, ensure competence, awareness, communication, and maintain documented information.
clauses.objective: Ensure the ISMS is supported with adequate resources and documented information.

clauses.title: Operation
clauses.description: Plan, implement, and control processes to meet information security requirements.
clauses.objective: Implement and operationalize all ISMS processes effectively.

clauses.title: Performance Evaluation
clauses.description: Monitor, measure, analyze, evaluate, conduct internal audits, and management reviews.

controls.title: Policies for information security
controls.description: Information security policy and topic-specific policies shall be defined, approved by management, published, communicated to, and acknowledged by relevant personnel.
controls.objective: Provide management direction and support for information security in accordance with business requirements.
controls.purpose: Establish the foundation of information security governance through documented policies.
controls.implementation_guidance: Develop an overarching Information Security Policy approved by top management. Create topic-specific policies (e.g., access control, acceptable use, mobile devices). Communicate to all staff. Review annually or upon significant changes.

controls.title: Acceptable use of information and other associated assets
controls.description: Rules for the acceptable use of, and procedures for handling, information and other associated assets shall be identified, documented, and implemented.
controls.objective: Ensure information and assets are used appropriately by all personnel.
controls.purpose: Define boundaries for acceptable use to prevent misuse.
controls.implementation_guidance: Draft an Acceptable Use Policy covering email, internet, cloud services, BYOD, and company devices. Require staff to acknowledge the policy on hire and annually. Monitor compliance.

controls.title: Return of assets
controls.description: Personnel and other interested parties shall return all organizational assets upon change or termination of employment.
controls.objective: Ensure organizational assets are returned and access revoked when individuals leave.
controls.purpose: Prevent unauthorized use of organizational assets post-employment.
controls.implementation_guidance: Implement an offboarding checklist requiring return of all devices, credentials, and access cards. HR to coordinate with IT. Document asset return in the exit process.

controls.title: Classification of information
controls.description: Information shall be classified according to the information security needs of the organization.
controls.objective: Ensure information receives appropriate level of protection.
controls.purpose: Enable consistent application of security controls based on information sensitivity.
controls.implementation_guidance: Define classification levels (e.g., Public, Internal, Confidential, Restricted). Document criteria for each. Train staff. Apply to all new information assets.

controls.title: Labelling of information
controls.description: An appropriate set of procedures for information labelling shall be developed and implemented.
controls.objective: Ensure information classification is communicated clearly on all information assets.
controls.purpose: Enable personnel to handle information according to its classification.
controls.implementation_guidance: Define labelling formats for each classification level. Apply to documents, emails, databases. Implement automatic labelling tools where feasible. Train staff on correct labelling.

controls.title: Information transfer
controls.description: Information transfer rules, procedures, or agreements shall be in place for all types of transfer facilities.
controls.objective: Protect information transferred within and outside the organization.
controls.purpose: Prevent unauthorized disclosure or loss of information during transfer.
controls.implementation_guidance: Define rules for email, file transfer, physical media, and cloud sharing. Implement data loss prevention (DLP). Require encryption for sensitive data. Use NDAs for external transfers.

controls.title: Access control
controls.description: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and other associated assets shall be established.
controls.objective: Prevent unauthorized access to information and systems.
controls.purpose: Protect organizational assets by ensuring only authorized access is granted.
controls.implementation_guidance: Develop an Access Control Policy. Implement role-based access control (RBAC). Review access rights quarterly. Apply least privilege principle. Log all access.

controls.title: Identity management
controls.description: The full lifecycle of identities shall be managed.
controls.objective: Ensure identities are created, maintained, and deleted appropriately.
controls.purpose: Maintain accurate and current identity information to support access control.
controls.implementation_guidance: Implement identity lifecycle management (provision, modify, deprovision). Use unique identifiers. Integrate with HR processes. Review dormant accounts monthly.

controls.title: Authentication information
controls.description: Allocation and management of authentication information shall be controlled by a management process.
controls.objective: Ensure authentication information is protected and managed securely.
controls.purpose: Prevent unauthorized access through compromised credentials.
controls.implementation_guidance: Implement a password policy (minimum length, complexity, rotation). Use MFA where possible. Store passwords in hashed form. Provide secure initial password distribution.

controls.title: Access rights
controls.description: Access rights to information and other associated assets shall be provisioned, reviewed, modified, and removed.
controls.objective: Ensure access rights are appropriate and current at all times.
controls.purpose: Minimize risk from excessive, outdated, or inappropriate access rights.
controls.implementation_guidance: Implement formal access request/approval process. Conduct quarterly access reviews. Remove access immediately on termination. Maintain access logs.

controls.title: Information security in supplier relationships
controls.description: Processes and procedures shall be defined and implemented to manage information security risks associated with the use of supplier's products or services.
controls.objective: Protect organizational information accessed or processed by suppliers.
controls.purpose: Manage supply chain information security risks.
controls.implementation_guidance: Define supplier security requirements. Include security clauses in contracts. Conduct supplier security assessments. Monitor supplier compliance regularly.

controls.title: Information security roles and responsibilities
controls.description: Information security roles and responsibilities shall be defined and allocated according to the needs of the organization.
controls.objective: Ensure clear ownership and accountability for information security.
controls.purpose: Define who is responsible for what in the ISMS.
controls.implementation_guidance: Define roles such as CISO, Data Owner, System Owner, Security Champion. Document in job descriptions. Assign responsibilities matrix (RACI). Communicate to all staff.

controls.title: Addressing information security within supplier agreements
controls.description: Relevant information security requirements shall be established and agreed with each supplier based on the type of supplier relationship.
controls.objective: Ensure suppliers are contractually bound to meet security requirements.
controls.purpose: Formalize supplier security obligations through binding agreements.
controls.implementation_guidance: Include standard security clauses in all supplier contracts. Define SLAs for security incidents. Require right-to-audit clauses. Ensure sub-processor controls.

controls.title: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
controls.description: Processes and procedures shall be defined and implemented to manage information security risks associated with the ICT products and services supply chain.
controls.objective: Manage security risks in hardware and software supply chains.
controls.purpose: Address risks from compromised hardware/software components in the supply chain.
controls.implementation_guidance: Verify integrity of ICT components. Assess suppliers' security practices. Monitor for supply chain attacks. Implement SBOM (Software Bill of Materials) practices.

controls.title: Monitoring, review, and change management of supplier services
controls.description: The organization shall regularly monitor, review, and manage changes to supplier service provisions.
controls.objective: Ensure suppliers maintain agreed security standards over time.
controls.purpose: Continuously validate supplier performance against security requirements.
controls.implementation_guidance: Conduct periodic supplier performance reviews. Include security metrics. Review contracts upon major changes. Track incidents involving suppliers.

controls.title: Information security for use of cloud services
controls.description: Processes for acquisition, use, management, and exit from cloud services shall be established in accordance with the organization's information security requirements.
controls.objective: Securely manage cloud service usage throughout its lifecycle.
controls.purpose: Govern cloud adoption with appropriate security controls.
controls.implementation_guidance: Develop a Cloud Security Policy. Assess cloud providers before adoption. Define shared responsibility model. Plan for cloud exit/portability. Monitor cloud environments.

controls.title: Information security incident management planning and preparation
controls.description: The organization shall plan and prepare for managing information security incidents.
controls.objective: Ensure rapid, effective response to information security incidents.
controls.purpose: Establish a structured incident response capability.
controls.implementation_guidance: Develop an Incident Response Plan. Define incident categories and severity levels. Establish an Incident Response Team (IRT). Test the plan at least annually.

controls.title: Assessment and decision on information security events
controls.description: The organization shall assess information security events and decide if they are to be categorized as information security incidents.
controls.objective: Ensure consistent evaluation and classification of security events.
controls.purpose: Enable appropriate response by correctly identifying incidents.
controls.implementation_guidance: Define criteria for classifying events as incidents. Use a triage process. Train first responders on classification. Document all classification decisions.

controls.title: Response to information security incidents
controls.description: Information security incidents shall be responded to in accordance with the documented procedures.
controls.objective: Contain, eradicate, and recover from security incidents effectively.
controls.purpose: Minimize the impact of security incidents through structured response.
controls.implementation_guidance: Follow the IRP for all confirmed incidents. Document containment, eradication, and recovery steps. Communicate with stakeholders. Preserve evidence for forensics.

controls.title: Learning from information security incidents
controls.description: Knowledge gained from information security incidents shall be used to strengthen and improve information security controls.
controls.objective: Improve security posture through lessons learned from incidents.
controls.purpose: Turn incidents into opportunities for security improvement.
controls.implementation_guidance: Conduct post-incident reviews. Document lessons learned. Update controls, procedures, and training based on findings. Track improvement actions.

controls.title: Collection of evidence
controls.description: The organization shall establish and implement procedures for the identification, collection, acquisition, and preservation of evidence related to information security events.
controls.objective: Ensure evidence is collected and preserved for disciplinary and legal proceedings.
controls.purpose: Enable effective investigation and legal action post-incident.
controls.implementation_guidance: Define evidence handling procedures. Train incident responders on forensic basics. Use write-blockers for physical media. Maintain chain of custody. Use digital forensic tools.

controls.title: Information security during disruption
controls.description: The organization shall plan how to maintain information security at an appropriate level during disruption.
controls.objective: Maintain security controls during adverse events and disasters.
controls.purpose: Prevent security degradation during business continuity events.
controls.implementation_guidance: Integrate security requirements into BCP/DRP. Define minimum security controls required during disruption. Test continuity arrangements regularly.

controls.title: Segregation of duties
controls.description: Conflicting duties and conflicting areas of responsibility shall be segregated.
controls.objective: Reduce opportunities for unauthorized or unintentional modification or misuse of assets.
controls.purpose: Prevent fraud and error by ensuring no single person controls all critical processes.
controls.implementation_guidance: Identify critical processes that require segregation. Map duties and identify conflicts. Implement compensating controls where segregation is not feasible. Document exceptions.

controls.title: ICT readiness for business continuity
controls.description: ICT readiness shall be planned, implemented, maintained, and tested based on business continuity objectives and ICT continuity requirements.
controls.objective: Ensure ICT systems can support business operations during disruption.
controls.purpose: Guarantee availability of critical ICT systems when needed most.
controls.implementation_guidance: Define RTO/RPO for critical systems. Implement redundancy and backup. Test recovery annually. Document ICT continuity plans.

controls.title: Legal, statutory, regulatory, and contractual requirements
controls.description: Legal, statutory, regulatory, and contractual requirements relevant to information security shall be identified, documented, and kept up to date.
controls.objective: Ensure compliance with all applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
controls.purpose: Avoid legal penalties and maintain compliance.
controls.implementation_guidance: Maintain a compliance register. Monitor regulatory updates. Assign compliance responsibilities. Review annually.

controls.title: Intellectual property rights
controls.description: The organization shall implement appropriate procedures to protect intellectual property rights.
controls.objective: Ensure compliance with intellectual property laws and regulations.
controls.purpose: Protect the organization from IP infringement liability.
controls.implementation_guidance: Implement software asset management. License tracking. Prohibit unauthorized software installation. Conduct regular audits.

controls.title: Protection of records
controls.description: Records shall be protected from loss, destruction, falsification, unauthorized access, and unauthorized release.
controls.objective: Ensure records are available when needed and protected from tampering.
controls.purpose: Maintain integrity and availability of organizational records.
controls.implementation_guidance: Define retention schedules. Implement access controls on records. Use immutable storage where possible. Test restoration regularly.

controls.title: Privacy and protection of personally identifiable information (PII)
controls.description: The organization shall identify and meet the requirements regarding the preservation of privacy and protection of PII according to applicable laws and regulations.
controls.objective: Protect personal data in compliance with privacy regulations.
controls.purpose: Maintain trust and comply with GDPR and other privacy laws.
controls.implementation_guidance: Appoint a DPO where required. Conduct DPIA. Implement privacy by design. Maintain records of processing activities (ROPA). Train staff on data protection.

controls.title: Independent review of information security
controls.description: The organization's approach to managing information security and its implementation shall be reviewed independently at planned intervals.
controls.objective: Ensure independent assurance of ISMS effectiveness.
controls.purpose: Provide objective assessment of the ISMS through independent audits.
controls.implementation_guidance: Conduct annual internal audits. Commission external audits or penetration tests. Report findings to management. Track remediation of findings.

controls.title: Compliance with policies, rules, and standards for information security
controls.description: Compliance with the organization's information security policy, topic-specific policies, rules, and standards shall be regularly reviewed.
controls.objective: Ensure all policies and standards are consistently followed.
controls.purpose: Identify and address compliance gaps proactively.
controls.implementation_guidance: Schedule periodic compliance reviews for each policy. Use compliance dashboards or checklists. Document findings and remediation. Report to management.

controls.title: Documented operating procedures
controls.description: Operating procedures for information processing facilities shall be documented and made available to personnel who need them.
controls.objective: Ensure consistent, correct operation of information processing systems.
controls.purpose: Prevent errors and security breaches caused by inconsistent procedures.
controls.implementation_guidance: Document all critical IT operating procedures. Store in accessible location. Review when systems change. Include startup/shutdown, backup, monitoring, and error handling procedures.

controls.title: Management responsibilities
controls.description: Management shall require all personnel to apply information security in accordance with the established information security policy.
controls.objective: Ensure management actively enforces information security compliance.
controls.purpose: Create accountability at the management level for information security.
controls.implementation_guidance: Include information security responsibilities in performance reviews. Ensure managers cascade security requirements to their teams. Conduct periodic compliance checks.

controls.title: Contact with authorities
controls.description: Appropriate contacts with relevant authorities shall be maintained.
controls.objective: Ensure timely flow of information security insights from authorities.
controls.purpose: Maintain relationships with regulatory bodies, law enforcement, and government agencies.
controls.implementation_guidance: Identify relevant regulatory bodies (data protection authority, CERT, law enforcement). Assign responsibility for maintaining contacts. Document contacts and escalation procedures.

controls.title: Contact with special interest groups
controls.description: Appropriate contacts with special interest groups, security forums, and professional associations shall be maintained.
controls.objective: Maintain awareness of current threats, vulnerabilities, and best practices.
controls.purpose: Leverage industry knowledge and collaborative intelligence sharing.
controls.implementation_guidance: Join ISACs, ISACA, (ISC)², local CERT communities. Subscribe to threat intelligence feeds. Share learnings with internal teams.

controls.title: Threat intelligence
controls.description: Information relating to information security threats shall be collected and analysed to produce threat intelligence.
controls.objective: Ensure awareness of and response to evolving threats.
controls.purpose: Use threat intelligence to proactively defend against relevant threats.
controls.implementation_guidance: Subscribe to threat intelligence feeds (e.g., MISP, STIX/TAXII). Assign staff to monitor and analyse. Share actionable intelligence with IT/security teams. Review threat landscape quarterly.

controls.title: Information security in project management
controls.description: Information security shall be integrated into project management.
controls.objective: Ensure security is considered in all projects from inception to completion.
controls.purpose: Embed security into the project lifecycle to avoid costly remediation later.
controls.implementation_guidance: Include security requirements in project charters. Conduct security reviews at project gates. Assign a security representative to projects. Include security testing in project acceptance criteria.

controls.title: Inventory of information and other associated assets
controls.description: An inventory of information and associated assets, including owners, shall be developed and maintained.
controls.objective: Identify and manage all information assets to protect them appropriately.
controls.purpose: You cannot protect what you don't know exists — an asset inventory is foundational.
controls.implementation_guidance: Create and maintain an asset register covering information assets, hardware, software, and services. Assign owners to each asset. Classify assets by criticality. Review at least annually.

controls.title: Screening
controls.description: Background verification checks on all candidates for employment shall be carried out prior to joining.
controls.objective: Reduce the risk of hiring individuals who may pose a security threat.
controls.purpose: Verify candidate suitability through background checks.
controls.implementation_guidance: Implement pre-employment screening (criminal checks, reference checks, education verification). Proportional to the role sensitivity. Repeat for high-risk roles. Document results.

controls.title: Terms and conditions of employment
controls.description: Employment contractual agreements shall state the responsibilities of personnel for information security.
controls.objective: Ensure employees understand their information security responsibilities.
controls.purpose: Create binding obligations for information security compliance.
controls.implementation_guidance: Include confidentiality obligations, AUP reference, and security responsibilities in employment contracts. Have employees sign before start. Update upon role change.

controls.title: Information security awareness, education, and training
controls.description: Personnel shall receive appropriate information security awareness, education, and training.
controls.objective: Ensure all personnel are equipped to fulfill their security responsibilities.
controls.purpose: Reduce human error and insider threat through education.
controls.implementation_guidance: Deliver annual security awareness training. Include phishing simulations. Role-specific training for IT/security staff. New hire onboarding training. Track completion.

controls.title: Disciplinary process
controls.description: A disciplinary process shall be formalized and communicated to take action against personnel who have committed an information security policy violation.
controls.objective: Deter policy violations and enforce accountability.
controls.purpose: Ensure consequences for security policy violations.
controls.implementation_guidance: Define a formal disciplinary process for security violations. Include in HR policy. Communicate to all staff. Apply consistently. Document all disciplinary actions.

controls.title: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
controls.description: Information security responsibilities that remain valid after termination or change of employment shall be defined, communicated to the employee or contractor, and enforced.
controls.objective: Maintain security obligations beyond employment.
controls.purpose: Protect confidential information after personnel leave.
controls.implementation_guidance: Include post-employment security obligations in contracts. Conduct exit interviews. Revoke all access immediately on termination. Follow up on outstanding obligations.

controls.title: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements
controls.description: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements reflecting the organization's needs for the protection of information shall be identified, documented, regularly reviewed, and signed.
controls.objective: Protect confidential information shared with employees, contractors, and third parties.
controls.purpose: Create enforceable confidentiality obligations.
controls.implementation_guidance: Use NDAs for employees, contractors, and third parties with access to sensitive information. Include in onboarding. Review NDAs annually. Maintain signed copies.

controls.title: Remote working
controls.description: Security measures shall be implemented when personnel are working remotely to protect information accessed, processed, or stored outside the organization's premises.
controls.objective: Protect organizational information in remote working environments.
controls.purpose: Extend organizational security controls to remote work scenarios.
controls.implementation_guidance: Define a Remote Working Policy. Require VPN for organizational system access. Ensure secure home network practices. Provide guidance on physical security of devices. Implement MDM.

controls.title: Information security event reporting
controls.description: The organization shall provide a mechanism for personnel to report observed or suspected information security events.
controls.objective: Enable timely reporting of security events by all personnel.
controls.purpose: Create a culture of security vigilance and reporting.
controls.implementation_guidance: Provide simple reporting mechanism (email, ticketing, hotline). Train all staff on what and how to report. Ensure no blame culture for good-faith reports. Acknowledge and close all reports.

controls.title: Physical security perimeters
controls.description: Security perimeters shall be defined and used to protect areas that contain information and other associated assets.
controls.objective: Prevent unauthorized physical access to information processing facilities.
controls.purpose: Establish physical boundaries to protect sensitive areas.
controls.implementation_guidance: Define secure zones (e.g., server rooms, data centers, offices). Implement physical barriers (walls, locked doors). Use access control systems. Conduct perimeter inspections.

controls.title: Storage media
controls.description: Storage media shall be managed through its lifecycle of acquisition, use, transportation, and disposal.
controls.objective: Protect information on storage media throughout its lifecycle.
controls.purpose: Prevent data leakage from improperly managed media.
controls.implementation_guidance: Maintain media inventory. Control use of removable media. Encrypt sensitive media. Securely dispose of media (wiping/shredding). Track transfers.

controls.title: Supporting utilities
controls.description: Information processing facilities shall be protected from power failures and other disruptions caused by failures in supporting utilities.
controls.objective: Ensure continuity of information processing through reliable utilities.
controls.purpose: Prevent disruption from utility failures.
controls.implementation_guidance: Install UPS for critical systems. Implement redundant power feeds. Test generators regularly. Monitor HVAC and power systems. Define escalation procedures.

controls.title: Cabling security
controls.description: Cables carrying power or data shall be protected from interception, interference, or damage.
controls.objective: Prevent physical tampering with network and power cables.
controls.purpose: Protect data integrity and availability through cable security.
controls.implementation_guidance: Route cables through secured conduits. Label all cables. Use fiber optics for sensitive runs. Inspect cable runs regularly. Lock cable access panels.

controls.title: Equipment maintenance
controls.description: Equipment shall be maintained correctly to ensure availability and integrity of information.
controls.objective: Maintain equipment in good working order to prevent failure.
controls.purpose: Ensure equipment reliability through regular maintenance.
controls.implementation_guidance: Schedule preventive maintenance for all critical equipment. Document maintenance activities. Follow manufacturer specifications. Only authorized personnel perform maintenance.

controls.title: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
controls.description: Items of equipment containing storage media shall be verified to ensure that any sensitive data and licensed software has been removed or securely overwritten prior to disposal or reuse.
controls.objective: Prevent data leakage through improperly disposed equipment.
controls.purpose: Ensure no sensitive data remains on decommissioned equipment.
controls.implementation_guidance: Implement secure data wiping (NIST 800-88). Use certified disposal vendors. Issue disposal certificates. Update asset register. Physically destroy media when wiping is insufficient.

controls.title: Physical entry
controls.description: Secure areas shall be protected by appropriate entry controls to ensure that only authorized personnel are allowed access.
controls.objective: Prevent unauthorized physical access to secure areas.
controls.purpose: Control who can enter sensitive areas.
controls.implementation_guidance: Implement access cards/badges. Use biometric controls for high-security areas. Maintain visitor logs. Escort visitors. Review access rights quarterly.

controls.title: Securing offices, rooms, and facilities
controls.description: Physical security for offices, rooms, and facilities shall be designed and implemented.
controls.objective: Protect organizational facilities from unauthorized access and damage.
controls.purpose: Ensure all workspaces are physically secured.
controls.implementation_guidance: Install locks on sensitive rooms. Implement clean desk policy. Secure meeting rooms. Lock physical media and sensitive documents. Secure printer areas.

controls.title: Physical security monitoring
controls.description: Premises shall be continuously monitored for unauthorized physical access.
controls.objective: Detect and deter unauthorized physical access.
controls.purpose: Maintain continuous awareness of physical security status.
controls.implementation_guidance: Install CCTV cameras in critical areas. Implement intrusion detection. Monitor logs regularly. Set alerts for after-hours access. Retain footage per local regulations.

controls.title: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
controls.description: Protection against physical and environmental threats, such as natural disasters, malicious attack, or accidents, shall be designed and implemented.
controls.objective: Protect facilities from physical and environmental hazards.
controls.purpose: Minimize damage from environmental incidents.
controls.implementation_guidance: Conduct environmental risk assessment. Install fire suppression, flood detection, and UPS. Separate from hazardous areas. Implement environmental monitoring systems.

controls.title: Working in secure areas
controls.description: Security measures for working in secure areas shall be designed and implemented.
controls.objective: Prevent security breaches in secure/sensitive areas.
controls.purpose: Minimize insider threat in secure areas.
controls.implementation_guidance: Apply need-to-know in secure areas. Prohibit mobile phones/cameras unless approved. Supervise visitors. Log all activity. Limit knowledge of secure area existence.

controls.title: Clear desk and clear screen
controls.description: Clear desk rules for papers and removable storage media and clear screen rules for information processing facilities shall be defined and appropriately enforced.
controls.objective: Prevent unauthorized access to information left unattended.
controls.purpose: Reduce physical exposure of sensitive information.
controls.implementation_guidance: Define clear desk/screen policy. Configure screen lock after 5 minutes. Train all staff. Conduct spot checks. Shred sensitive documents.
required_policies: Clear Desk and Clear Screen Policy

controls.title: Equipment siting and protection
controls.description: Equipment shall be sited and protected to reduce the risks from physical and environmental threats and from unauthorized access.
controls.objective: Minimize physical risk to information processing equipment.
controls.purpose: Protect equipment from damage and unauthorized access.
controls.implementation_guidance: Site servers in secure data centers or rooms. Protect from heat, moisture, EMI. Implement raised floors, power conditioning, and cooling. Restrict physical access to equipment.

controls.title: Security of assets off-premises
controls.description: Off-site assets shall be protected.
controls.objective: Protect organizational assets used outside organizational premises.
controls.purpose: Extend security controls to assets used remotely.
controls.applicability: Organizations with remote workers or mobile assets
controls.implementation_guidance: Implement full disk encryption. Enable remote wipe. Track device locations. Prohibit leaving devices unattended. Provide secure travel guidelines.

controls.title: User endpoint devices
controls.description: Information stored on, processed by, or accessible via user endpoint devices shall be protected.
controls.objective: Secure endpoint devices against threats.
controls.purpose: Protect data on all user devices.
controls.implementation_guidance: Deploy EDR/antivirus on all endpoints. Enable full disk encryption. Apply security baselines. Implement patch management. Configure automatic lock screens.

controls.title: Information deletion
controls.description: Information stored in information systems, devices, or in any other storage media shall be deleted when no longer required.
controls.objective: Ensure information is securely deleted when no longer needed.
controls.purpose: Prevent unauthorized access to residual data.
controls.implementation_guidance: Define retention schedules. Implement secure deletion tools. Verify deletion of data in cloud and on media. Document deletion activities. Cover backup and archive systems.

controls.title: Data masking
controls.description: Data masking shall be used in accordance with the organization's topic-specific policy on access control and other related topic-specific policies.
controls.objective: Protect sensitive data through masking in non-production environments.
controls.purpose: Reduce exposure of sensitive data in testing and development.
controls.applicability: Organizations with sensitive data in non-production systems
controls.implementation_guidance: Implement data masking for test/dev environments. Use tokenization for PII. Ensure masked data cannot be reversed. Test masking effectiveness.

controls.title: Data leakage prevention
controls.description: Data leakage prevention measures shall be applied to systems, networks, and any other devices that process, store, or transmit sensitive information.
controls.objective: Prevent unauthorized exfiltration of sensitive data.
controls.purpose: Detect and block unauthorized data transfers.
controls.implementation_guidance: Deploy DLP solutions for email, endpoint, and network. Define DLP policies for sensitive data types (PII, financial). Monitor and alert on policy violations. Tune rules regularly.

controls.title: Information backup
controls.description: Backup copies of information, software, and system images shall be maintained and regularly tested in accordance with the agreed backup policy.
controls.objective: Ensure data can be restored in the event of loss or corruption.
controls.purpose: Protect data availability through reliable backups.
controls.implementation_guidance: Define backup schedule (daily, weekly). Follow 3-2-1 rule. Encrypt backups. Store offsite. Test restoration at least quarterly. Document RTO/RPO.

controls.title: Redundancy of information processing facilities
controls.description: Information processing facilities shall be implemented with redundancy sufficient to meet availability requirements.
controls.objective: Ensure availability of critical systems through redundancy.
controls.purpose: Prevent single points of failure in critical systems.
controls.implementation_guidance: Implement high availability for critical systems. Use load balancing and clustering. Define failover procedures. Test failover regularly. Align with RTO/RPO.

controls.title: Logging
controls.description: Logs that record activities, exceptions, faults, and other relevant events shall be produced, stored, protected, and analysed.
controls.objective: Maintain an audit trail for security events and system activities.
controls.purpose: Support incident investigation and compliance through comprehensive logging.
controls.implementation_guidance: Enable logging on all critical systems. Define log retention (min. 12 months). Centralize logs in SIEM. Protect logs from tampering. Review logs regularly.

controls.title: Monitoring activities
controls.description: Networks, systems, and applications shall be monitored for anomalous behaviour, and appropriate actions shall be taken to evaluate potential information security incidents.
controls.objective: Detect security threats and anomalies in real time.
controls.purpose: Enable rapid detection and response through continuous monitoring.
controls.implementation_guidance: Deploy SIEM for correlation. Use IDS/IPS. Monitor user behavior with UEBA. Define alert thresholds. Assign SOC analysts for 24/7 monitoring where critical.

controls.title: Clock synchronisation
controls.description: The clocks of information processing systems used by the organization shall be synchronized to approved time sources.
controls.objective: Ensure accurate and consistent timestamps across all systems.
controls.purpose: Support forensic investigations and log correlation with accurate timestamps.
controls.implementation_guidance: Configure NTP on all systems pointing to reliable time sources (e.g., GPS-based, national time servers). Monitor for time drift. Include in system baselines.

controls.title: Use of privileged utility programs
controls.description: The use of utility programs that might be capable of overriding system and application controls shall be restricted and tightly controlled.
controls.objective: Prevent misuse of privileged utility tools.
controls.purpose: Minimize the risk of system compromise through utility programs.
controls.implementation_guidance: Restrict access to admin/utility tools. Approve use on case-by-case basis. Log all use. Remove utilities not required. Implement application control (whitelisting).

controls.title: Installation of software on operational systems
controls.description: Procedures and measures shall be implemented to securely manage software installation on operational systems.
controls.objective: Prevent unauthorized or malicious software installation.
controls.purpose: Maintain integrity of operational systems.
controls.implementation_guidance: Restrict admin rights on endpoints. Implement application whitelisting. Use software deployment tools. Test in non-production before deploying. Maintain approved software list.

controls.title: Privileged access rights
controls.description: The allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted and managed.
controls.objective: Minimize the risk from abuse of privileged access.
controls.purpose: Control and monitor privileged account usage.
controls.implementation_guidance: Inventory all privileged accounts. Apply just-in-time (JIT) access. Use Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions. Log all privileged activity. Review quarterly.

controls.title: Networks security
controls.description: Networks and network devices shall be secured, managed, and controlled to protect information in systems and applications.
controls.objective: Secure the organizational network against threats.
controls.purpose: Protect data in transit and prevent unauthorized network access.
controls.implementation_guidance: Implement firewalls and DMZ. Segment networks. Use VLANs. Monitor network traffic. Perform network penetration tests. Document network architecture.

controls.title: Security of network services
controls.description: Security mechanisms, service levels, and service requirements of all network services shall be identified, implemented, and monitored.
controls.objective: Ensure network services are securely provided.
controls.purpose: Manage security of internal and outsourced network services.
controls.implementation_guidance: Identify all network services. Define security requirements for each. Implement authentication for service access. Monitor service performance and security. Include in supplier agreements.

controls.title: Segregation of networks
controls.description: Groups of information services, users, and information systems shall be segregated in networks.
controls.objective: Limit the spread of security incidents through network segmentation.
controls.purpose: Contain breaches through network isolation.
controls.implementation_guidance: Segment networks by function (user, server, DMZ, guest). Use VLANs and firewalls between segments. Limit inter-segment traffic to minimum necessary. Monitor inter-segment traffic.

controls.title: Web filtering
controls.description: Access to external websites shall be managed to reduce exposure to malicious content.
controls.objective: Prevent access to malicious websites.
controls.purpose: Protect users from web-based threats.
controls.implementation_guidance: Deploy web proxy with category filtering. Block known malicious domains. Filter phishing sites. Monitor and review blocked categories. Apply to remote workers via cloud proxy.

controls.title: Use of cryptography
controls.description: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management, shall be defined and implemented.
controls.objective: Protect data confidentiality and integrity through cryptography.
controls.purpose: Establish cryptographic standards for protecting sensitive data.
controls.implementation_guidance: Define cryptography policy (approved algorithms, key lengths). Implement PKI. Use TLS 1.2+ for all communications. Encrypt data at rest and in transit. Manage keys securely (HSM where possible).

controls.title: Secure development life cycle
controls.description: Rules for the secure development of software and systems shall be established and applied.
controls.objective: Build security into software from the start.
controls.purpose: Reduce vulnerabilities through secure development practices.
controls.implementation_guidance: Implement SSDLC. Include security requirements in design. Conduct threat modeling. Use secure coding standards (OWASP). Integrate SAST/DAST in CI/CD. Train developers in secure coding.

controls.title: Application security requirements
controls.description: Information security requirements shall be identified, specified, and approved when developing or acquiring applications.
controls.objective: Ensure applications meet security requirements before acquisition or deployment.
controls.purpose: Define and validate application security requirements.
controls.implementation_guidance: Define security requirements at project inception. Use security requirements templates. Validate during testing. Include in vendor RFPs for acquired applications.

controls.title: Secure system architecture and engineering principles
controls.description: Principles for engineering secure systems shall be established, documented, maintained, and applied to any information system implementation.
controls.objective: Implement security as a core principle in system design.
controls.purpose: Build secure systems through principled engineering.
controls.implementation_guidance: Adopt secure-by-design principles. Implement defense in depth. Apply least privilege in architecture. Use zero trust principles. Document architecture decisions with security rationale.

controls.title: Secure coding
controls.description: Secure coding principles shall be applied to software development.
controls.objective: Prevent common coding vulnerabilities.
controls.purpose: Produce secure code through disciplined practices.
controls.implementation_guidance: Adopt OWASP Top 10 mitigations. Use static analysis tools (SAST). Conduct code reviews. Train developers. Implement input validation everywhere. Avoid known insecure functions.

controls.title: Security testing in development and acceptance
controls.description: Security testing processes shall be defined and implemented in the development life cycle.
controls.objective: Identify security vulnerabilities before software is deployed.
controls.purpose: Validate security through rigorous testing.
controls.implementation_guidance: Define security testing plan. Include SAST, DAST, and penetration testing. Conduct security acceptance testing. Track and remediate findings before go-live.

controls.title: Information access restriction
controls.description: Access to information and application system functions shall be restricted in accordance with the access control policy.
controls.objective: Enforce access control at the application level.
controls.purpose: Prevent unauthorized access to application functions and data.
controls.implementation_guidance: Implement role-based access control (RBAC) in all applications. Apply least privilege. Restrict menu options and views by role. Regularly review application access.

controls.title: Outsourced development
controls.description: The organization shall direct, monitor, and review the activities related to outsourced system development.
controls.objective: Ensure outsourced development meets security requirements.
controls.purpose: Manage security risks in third-party development.
controls.implementation_guidance: Include security requirements in outsourcing contracts. Conduct code reviews of delivered code. Test for vulnerabilities. Require NDAs and IP ownership clauses.

controls.title: Separation of development, test, and production environments
controls.description: Development, testing, and production environments shall be separated and secured.
controls.objective: Prevent development/test activities from impacting production.
controls.purpose: Protect production systems from development risks.
controls.implementation_guidance: Maintain separate dev, test, and prod environments. Restrict access to production. Prohibit use of real data in non-prod (use masked data). Document environment differences.

controls.title: Change management
controls.description: Changes to information processing facilities and information systems shall be subject to change management procedures.
controls.objective: Prevent unauthorized or disruptive changes to information systems.
controls.purpose: Control changes through a formal process to minimize security risk.
controls.implementation_guidance: Implement formal change management process (RFC, CAB). Assess security impact of all changes. Test changes in non-prod first. Maintain change log. Roll-back plans required.

controls.title: Test information
controls.description: Test information shall be appropriately selected, protected, and managed.
controls.objective: Protect sensitive information used in testing.
controls.purpose: Prevent test activities from exposing production data.
controls.implementation_guidance: Define rules for test data selection. Use anonymized or synthetic data. Apply same controls as production if real data must be used. Secure test environments.

controls.title: Protection of information systems during audit testing
controls.description: Audit tests and other assurance activities involving assessment of operational systems shall be planned and agreed to minimise disruptions to business processes.
controls.objective: Ensure audit activities do not disrupt normal operations.
controls.purpose: Manage audit risks to production systems.
controls.implementation_guidance: Plan audit tests with IT. Obtain approvals. Conduct during low-traffic windows. Limit audit access to read-only where possible. Monitor systems during audit. Document findings.

controls.title: Access to source code
controls.description: Read and write access to source code, development tools, and software libraries shall be appropriately managed.
controls.objective: Protect source code from unauthorized access or modification.
controls.purpose: Prevent code tampering and intellectual property theft.
controls.implementation_guidance: Restrict source code repository access to developers. Implement code review processes. Log all access. Disable production access for developers. Use separate build accounts.

controls.title: Secure authentication
controls.description: Secure authentication technologies and procedures shall be implemented based on information access restrictions.
controls.objective: Ensure only authenticated users access organizational systems.
controls.purpose: Prevent unauthorized access through robust authentication.
controls.implementation_guidance: Implement MFA for all systems. Use SSO where possible. Enforce strong password policies. Monitor failed login attempts. Block accounts after repeated failures.

controls.title: Capacity management
controls.description: The use of resources shall be monitored and adjusted, and projections of future capacity requirements shall be made.
controls.objective: Ensure adequate system capacity to meet business needs.
controls.purpose: Prevent outages due to capacity exhaustion.
controls.implementation_guidance: Monitor CPU, memory, storage, and network utilization. Set capacity thresholds and alerts. Forecast capacity needs quarterly. Scale proactively.

controls.title: Protection against malware
controls.description: Protection against malware shall be implemented and supported by appropriate user awareness.
controls.objective: Detect and prevent malware infections.
controls.purpose: Protect systems and data from malicious software.
controls.implementation_guidance: Deploy anti-malware on all endpoints and email gateways. Keep signatures updated. Scan all file transfers. Block known malicious sites. Train users on social engineering.

controls.title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
controls.description: Information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems in use shall be obtained in a timely fashion, the organization's exposure to such vulnerabilities evaluated, and appropriate measures taken.
controls.objective: Identify and remediate technical vulnerabilities before they are exploited.
controls.purpose: Maintain a strong security posture through vulnerability management.
controls.implementation_guidance: Subscribe to vulnerability feeds. Conduct regular vulnerability scans. Prioritize patching (CVSS score). Track remediation. Penetration test annually.

controls.title: Configuration management
controls.description: Configurations, including security configurations, of hardware, software, services, and networks shall be established, documented, implemented, monitored, and reviewed.
controls.objective: Maintain secure and consistent configurations across all systems.
controls.purpose: Prevent security weaknesses from misconfiguration.
controls.implementation_guidance: Define security baselines for all systems. Use CIS Benchmarks. Implement automated configuration management (e.g., Ansible, Chef). Monitor for configuration drift. Review changes via Change Management.
